description: In combination with `pdClim-control`, quantifies tropospheric ozone effective radiative forcing (ERF) relative to a present-day base state. Same as `pdClim-control`, except anthropogenic non-CH4 tropospheric O3 precursor emissions use pre-industrial (1850) values. Methane uses 1850 values in the chemistry scheme only and remains at 2021 values in the radiation scheme.
